definitions.gloss: valued customer; regular patron; loyal client
definitions.explanation: A polite and respectful term for a regular customer or client who has an ongoing business relationship. The お～{様|さま} form adds honorific politeness.

examples.japanese: あの{方|かた}はお{得意様|とくいさま}です。
examples.english: That person is a valued customer.

examples.japanese: お{得意様|とくいさま}には{特別|とくべつ}{割引|わりびき}をご{用意|ようい}しております。
examples.english: We offer special discounts for our valued customers.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}のお{得意様|とくいさま}を{大切|たいせつ}にすることが、{商売|しょうばい}を{長|なが}く{続|つづ}ける{秘訣|ひけつ}だ。
examples.english: The secret to sustaining a business long-term is to value your long-standing customers.

notes:
The polite form of {得意先|とくいさき}/{得意客|とくいきゃく}. The お～{様|さま} honorific wrapping makes this suitable for directly addressing or referring to customers in a respectful business context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{得意様|とくいさま}{向|む}け: aimed at valued customers
- お{得意様|とくいさま}{限定|げんてい}: exclusive to regular customers
- {長年|ながねん}のお{得意様|とくいさま}: long-standing customer

RELATED WORDS:
- {得意先|とくいさき}: client, customer (business term) — used within the company to refer to business clients
- {常連|じょうれん}: regular (customer) — more casual, used for restaurants, bars, and shops
- {顧客|こきゃく}: customer, client — formal/neutral business term without the honorific warmth
- お{客様|きゃくさま}: customer — general polite term for any customer
